author: mashed
description:
The great truth-teller of our age is back! The Donkey Kong Experience returns with long-standing guest Shadow the Hedgehog for a brand-new episode of the controversial podcast. Our great bastions of knowledge tackle the great questions of our age - just how hairless is Mario? Is DK actually a cryptid? And who is the greatest Alpha (or Sigma. Or Beta) male in the studio?
